{pañcaratnavyākhyācatuṣṭayam}
(pañcaratnavyākhyā- tantrasāraprakāśikā pṛ0. 1-21) (pañcaratnavyākhyā- tārakadīpikā pṛ0. 22-28) (pañcaratnavyākhyā- śivatattvaprakāśikā pṛ0. 29-36) (pañcaratnavyākhyā- śrutyarthaprakāśikā pṛ0. 37-66)
(1. pañcaratnavyākhyā- tantrasāraprakāśikā ḍ 5087 pṛ0. 1-21) (2. pañcaratnavyākhyā- tārakadīpikā ḍ 5088 pṛ0. 22-28) (3. pañcaratnavyākhyā- śivatattvaprakāśikā ḍ 5089 pṛ0. 29-36) (4. pañcaratnavyākhyā- śrutyarthaprakāśikā ḍ 5090 pṛ0. 37-)
{pañcaratnavyākhyā(-)tantrasāraprakāśikā} ||
śivāya namaḥ || tantrasāraprakāśikā || śivaṃ śrīvīraṇārādhyaṃ natvā kurve samāsataḥ | vyākhyāṃ śrīpañcaratnasya tantrasāraprakāśikām || natvā patiṃ tatsamaveta śaktiṃ ṣaḍadhva hetuṃ paramāṃ parāṃ vā || vakṣye trayāṇāṃ paśusaṃcayānāṃ pāśātmanāṃ lakṣaṇamadhvanāṃ ca || athāsya tantrasāra pañcaratnasya vyākhyāṃ taṃtrasāraprakāśikākhyāṃ saṃkṣepataścikīrṣuḥ prathamaṃ patilakṣaṇamāha natveti | patiṃ patipadārtharūpaṃ paraśivaṃ natvā || taduktaṃ nārāyaṇopaniṣadi(-) patiṃ viśvasyātmeśvaraṃ śāśvataṃ śivamacyutam || tathā śrīmatkiraṇe(-) tathā nādiḥ śivaḥ kartā sarvasya jagataḥ sthitaḥ | yathā kālohyabda(?) vi (*) rtāpi dṛśyate phalasādhanaḥ || evaṃ śivo hyamūrto'pi kurute kāryamicchayā || śrīmanmṛgendre(-) athopalabhyate (****) kāryatva dharmakam | kartāramasya jānīyo viśiṣṭamanumānataḥ || pauṣkare(-) vivādādhyasitaṃ viśvaṃ viśvavitkartṛpūrvakam | kāryatvādāvayoḥ siddhaṃ kāryaṃ kumbhādikaṃ yathā|| layabhogādhikārātma vyāpāra traya lakṣitaḥ || svabhāvādacyutaḥ śaktaḥ padārthaḥ patisaṃjñitaḥ || parākhye(-) mūrtāḥ sāvayavāḥ (hya)rthā nānārūpa paricchadāḥ|| sthūlā vayava śiṣṭatvādbuddhimaddhetu pūrvakāḥ || ato'sti buddhimān kaścidīśvaraḥ samavasthitaḥ ||
viśvasārottare(-) acetanasya māyādeḥ pravartakatayā patiḥ | siddhaḥ sarvārtha vitkartā vyāpakaḥ satatoditaḥ || ityādi sakala (*******) gama prakaraṇaiḥ patidārthaḥ prasiddhaḥ | atha patirūpakṛtye āha vṛddhajābālopaniṣadi(-) ṅirañjano nityasvarūpaḥ (****) vādānadhyāsuḥ sakalāgama saṃvedya iti || śrīmṛgendre(-) tadvapuḥ pañcabhirmantraiḥ pañcakṛtyopayogibhiḥ | īśa tatpuruṣāghoravāmādyairmastakādikam || jagajjanmasthitidhvaṃsa tirobhāva vimuktayaḥ || kṛtyaṃ sakārakaphalaṃ jñeyamasyai tadeva hi || pauṣkare(-) yathārkaḥ paṅkajaṃ nityaṃ bodha saṃśoṣaṇādibhiḥ | karmabhirbodhakākhyābhirlabhate'tra tathā śivaḥ|| bindukṣobho yataḥ śambhoḥ śaktireva pravartate || jñānakriyātmikā sāpi satyāni (******) ta prabhuḥ| ananyasya śivāsyaiva vastuto mūrtiraiśvarī || atha samavetaśaktisvarūpamāha (-) tatsamavetaśaktiṃ natveti | śvetāśvataropaniṣadi(-) parāsyaśaktirvividhaiva śrūyate svābhāvikī jñānabalakriyā ca|| mṛgendre(-) karaṇaṃ ca na śaktyanyacchaktirvā cetanācitaḥ| niṣayāniyamādekabodhe kṛtye ca tattathā || ratnatraye(-) śaktirapratighodāramarīci nicayātmikā | citireva matāmlāna mahimā parameṣṭhinaḥ || pauṣkare(-) vyāpakaṃ nityamacalaṃ sarvatomukhamaiśvaram | tasminvispaṣṭacinmātro vyāpakatvādi dharmavān || ananyonyaśca tacchaktiḥ samavāyātsthitaḥ śivaḥ | ityādi|| atha śuddhamāyāsvarūpamāha(-) ṣaḍadhva hetum | varṇādi ṣaḍadhva nidānabhūtāṃ paramāṃ utkṛṣṭāṃ parāṃ vā kuṇḍalinīṃ natveti|
śvetāśvatopaniṣadi(-) māyāṃ tu prakṛtiṃ viṃdyā diti|| pauṣkare(-) vāgīśvarī parāvidyā kuṭilā kuṇḍalī parā | śuddhamāyā paro binduḥ śabda brahmeti kathyate || ratnatraye(-) jāyatedhvā yataḥ śuddho vartate yatra līyate | sa binduḥ paranādākhyo nādabindvurna (***) m | kanda(?)ḥ paramānando śivo nityoditaḥ prabhuḥ || nāstameti nacodeti na śrānto na vikāravān | sarvabhūtāntara caraḥ śabda brahmātmako raviḥ|| pauṣkare(-) nāḍakuṇḍalinī śaṃbhoḥ śakteḥ śuddhā jaḍātmikā | na tādātmyātsthitā kiṃ tu vartamānā parigrahe | śive kartari tādātmyānneyaṃ kuṇḍalinī sthitā || upādānatvato hetoḥ kulāle mṛttikā yathā | vṛttistatvātmikā cāsyāścaturdhā saṃvyavasthitā || śivatatvaṃ sadeśākhyamaiśaṃvidyāhvayaṃ tathā || śuddhānyetāni tatvāni rudrāṇūnāṃ mahātmanām || ityādi | atha parāvyavasthāmāha bṛhadāraṇyakopaniṣadi(-) vācaṃ dhenumupāsīta tasyāścatvārasstanāstasyāḥ prāṇabhūṣa bho mano vatsāḥ | viśvasārottare(-) tasyāścatasro vāgrūpā vṛttayo vaikharīmukhāḥ vaikharī madhyamā cānyā paśyantī sūkṣmasaṃjñitā siddhānta vaikharī | mūlādhāre parā proktā paśyantī hṛdaye sthitā | madhyamā kaṇṭhadeśasyā tālvoṣṭha puṭavaikharī || pauṣkare(-) mūrdhni (****) dādhvani śiraḥ (***) (*) miśradhvani sthitāḥ| aśuddhādhvanitā vācaḥ sthūlāt sthūlatarā sthitāḥ|| ityādi | atha ṣaḍadhvotpattimāha(-) mahopaniṣadi(-) adhvanāmadhvapateḥ śreṣṭhasyādhvanaḥ pāramaśīyeti | svāyaṃbhuve(-) kāryāṇi nāma tasyāśca ṣaḍadhvānāṃ prakīrtitāḥ | varṇādhvā ca padādhvā ca mantrādhvā bhuvanādhvakaḥ || tatvādhvā ca kalādhvā cetyadhvānaḥ ṣaḍamī matāḥ || ṣauṣkare(-) śabdarūpāstrayasteṣāṃmartharūpāstrayaḥ smṛtāḥ |
varṇādhvātra samākhyātaḥ pañcāśadvarṇasañcayaḥ || ekāśīti padānyeva padādhveti nigadyate | pañcabhirbrahmabhiścāṅgairmantrādhvā sadbhirucyate || śatadvaya caturviṃśadbhuvano bhuvanārthakaḥ || ṣaṭtriṃśattvasaṃyuktaḥ tatvādhveti prakīrtitaḥ || śāntyatītā ca śāntiśca vidyā sārdhaṃ pratiṣṭhayā | nivṛttiśceti bhidayā kalādhvā pañcacoditāḥ || tathā tātparyasaṃgrahe(-) adhvānamadhvapatimadhvani tāratamyaṃ(,) śreṣṭhādhva pāragamanaṃ saphalaṃ bravīti | ma(....)ḍhvanāmiti maheśvara gṛhyakāraḥ | pitrākumāramupanīya yamāhavākyaṃ(.......) ityādi | athādho māyāsvarūpamāha(-) śvetāśvataropaniṣadi(-) māyāṃ tu prakṛtiṃ vidyāditi | tathā svāyaṃbhuve(-) māyātatvaṃ jagadbījamavināśyaṃ śivātmakam | vi (**) makalaṃ sūkṣmamanādyavyayamīśvaram || mṛgendre(-) granthijanyaṃ kalākāla vidyārāga nṛmātaraḥ| guṇādhigarva cittākṣa paśu (**) nyanukramāt || tathā pauṣkare(-) kālo niyatiśca kalā sākṣānmāyodbhavāni ca | raurave(-) kalātatvādrāgavidye dve tatpu (*****)|| pauṣkare(-) pañcakañcukasaṃyuktaḥ prakṛtiṃ bhoktumudyataḥ | avidyādi samāyuktaḥ puruṣaḥ parikīrtitaḥ || (*****) tu kramāyātaṃ nirūpyate | tacca māyodbhavaṃ yasmātkalātaḥ sthūlatāṃ gatam || kiraṇe(-) viśvarājādhirāje (*****) bhya mantrarāṭ | śivaśaktiprabhāvācca kilānantaḥ prabudhyate || pauṣkare(-) atha prakṛti tatvācca guṇatatvamajāyata | kṣobhaka (*****) śrīkaṇṭhonantavikramaḥ || guṇatatvātparābuddhirabhavanmunipuṅgavāḥ | ata ūrdhvamahaṃkāra tatvasaṃ (***) rtyate || sa ca trividha uddiṣṭaḥ prathamastatra taijasaḥ |
vaikāriko dvitīyaḥ syāttathā bhūtādikaḥ paraḥ | taijasādapyahaṃkārānmanobuddhīndriyāṇi ca | pañcakarmendriyāṇi syurahaṃkārāttu vaikṛtāt || ahaṃkārāttu bhūtāderjātā tanmātra saṃhatiḥ | mahābhūtāni jāyante kramāttanmātra pañcakāt || mataṅge(-) māyāntarvartinaḥ proktāḥ paśavaḥ pāśadharmiṇa ityādi | atha paśulakṣaṇamāha(-) trayāṇāṃ paśusañcayānāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ vakṣya iti | śvetāśvataropaniṣadi(-) aniśaścātmā bādhyate bhoktṛbhāvājjñātvā devaṃ mucyate sarvapāśaiḥ | kiraṇe paśurnityo hyamūrtajño niṣkriyo nirguṇo prabhuḥ | vyāpīmāyodarāntastho bhogopāya vicintakaḥ || pauṣkare(-) paśuḥ paśutvasaṃyogādamuktaḥ paśurucyate | yasmāsvadra kriyāśālī kalāhīno'pyanīśvaraḥ || siddhāntaśekhare(-) nityo mūḍhaḥ parādhīnaḥ kartā bhoktā paśuḥ pumān || atha paśubhedamāha(-) kāraṇe(-) paśavastrividhā jñeyā sakalaḥ pralayākalaḥ | vijñānākala ityuktāsteṣāṃ lakṣaṇamucyate || bhedoyaḥ sakalādīnāṃ pāśabandhaviśeṣataḥ | māyā karma malaiḥ pāśaiḥ saṃyuktaḥ sakalaḥ smṛtaḥ || pāśābhyāṃ malakarmabhyāṃ saṃbaddhaḥ pralayākalaḥ | malaikapāśasaṃyukto vijñānākala ucyate || pauṣkare(-) malenaikena baddheṣu vijñānākalanāmasu | malapākamapekṣyaiva kāṃścicchuddhā (*) gocare || yoda(ja)yatyādhikāreṣu (*) tvā dṛkkriyayotkaṭān | kāṃścidbhogāhvaye tatve tatvenyānīśvarāhvaye || anyānvidyāhvaye tatve sarvajñān balaśālinaḥ | malapākavaśāḥ (*) kṣuteṣṭhaṣṭāvadhikāriṇaḥ || baindavena śarīreṇa yuktāḥ sarvajñatāyutāḥ |
sadāśiva guṇopetāḥ mahāntaścakravartinaḥ | atisaundarya lāvaṇyā lakṣiṇa manasastathā || adhikāravaśācchaṃbhornyūna kartṛtvaśaktayaḥ | sthiti saṃrakṣaṇādāna bhavānugrahakāriṇaḥ || vasantaśceśvare tatve māyā garbhādhikāriṇaḥ | teṣāmanantaḥ prathamaḥ tataḥ sūkṣmaśivottamaḥ || ekanetraika rudrau ca trimūrtiśca kramāttataḥ | śrīkaṇṭhaśca śikhaṇḍī ca te'dho'dho nyūnaśaktayaḥ || yo hi yasmādguṇotkṛṣṭaḥ sa tasmādūrdhvamiṣyate | tathā parāṃśca mantreśān vidyātatva nivāsinaḥ | karoti śiva evaite saṃkhyayā saptakoṭayaḥ || dīkṣākaraṇabhūtānāṃ mantraṇāmīśvarā iti || mantreśvarāste kathitāḥ lokānugrahakāriṇaḥ | sarvajñā api mantreśāste'dho'dho nyūnaśaktayaḥ || trayo (**) deha sāpekṣaṃ tadarddhamakhile'dhvani | kṛtvādhikāraṃ sthityante śivaṃ viśati seśvaram || vinādhikaraṇe nā (**) na vikṛteradhaḥ kṛtvādhikāramāśeṣṭamupaitisvādhvasaṃhṛt | malapākavaśādyogya śivānugrahasaṃyutam | saptakoṭya itye (*****) rdhvaṃ vimocitam | ye tvapakvamalāssanti vijñānākala nāmasu | te yāvanmalapākāntaṃ tiṣṭhanti malamātra (*) || (****) kalābhiśca karmabhiśca kadācana | vijñāna kevalāḥ sākṣāt ta eva munipuṅgavāḥ || adhikāra malopetāḥ śive (*) nu matāḥ sadā| atha pūrva samuddiṣṭa pralayākalanāmasu | supakkamalakarmāṇaste yānti (*****) ||
tathā parāṃśca mantreśaḥ pralayā kalanāmasu | baddheṣu malakarmabhyāṃ malapākānusārataḥ || māyāgarbhādhikārā (***) śca śivadīkṣayā | nivṛtta malakarmāṇaḥ paramantreśvaraiḥ kṛtaiḥ || kalādibhiśca sahitā māyāgarbhādhikārakaiḥ | (*****) jairdehai yuktāstadavaśīkṛtāḥ || bhuvaneśān karotīśaḥ te tu pañcāṣṭakādayaḥ | kāmike(-) pakvatripā (**) sakalāstathā pakvatriśakāḥ | syuḥ krodhādyā maṇḍalinaḥ śatarudrāstathā pare || śrīkaṇṭho vīrabhadraśca pakvapāśatrayāḥ smṛtāḥ | anye cākṣīṇa pāśāste baddhāḥ saṃsāriṇaḥ smṛtāḥ | raurave(-) śatarudrāstu te proktāḥ brahmāṇḍe paritaḥ kramāt || daśadikparirakṣārthaṃ sthitā rudrāḥ puroditāḥ | ekaikasyāṃ diśi diśi smṛtā daśa daśa kramāt || śrīkaṇṭhādhiṣṭhitāḥ santa śatarudrā mahaujasaḥ | te svatulyamavedhyaiśvaryaṃ brahmādīnāṃ prajāsṛjām || prayacchanti mahātmāno devebhyaścāmitaujasaḥ | te'pi māyāṃ janāḥ proktā brahmaviṣṇvindrasaṃjñakāḥ(jñitāḥ) | vīrabhadrādayaścaite mājāṃjana vivarjitāḥ || vīrabhadra iti khyātaḥ śatarudrādhipastathā | te tu maṇḍalinoṣṭau ca kalā mastakavāsinaḥ || krodhādayastathā cāṣṭau guṇatatvo paristhitāḥ | śrīkaṇṭho guṇatatvasthaḥ tadadho bhuvanādhipaḥ || teṣāmutpattisaṃhārasthityanugrahakāraṇam || pauṣkare(-) paśusvarūpamityuktaṃ pāśarūpamathocyate || atha pāśalakṣaṇamāha(-) trayāṇāṃ pāśātmanāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ vakṣye iti ||
kiraṇe(-) ātmasthaṃ tatpaśutvaṃ syāt paśurapyadhva madhyagaḥ | proktameva malastena malastadbhinnalakṣaṇaḥ || malo'jñānaṃ paśutvaṃ ca tiraskāra karastamaḥ | avidyā vyāvṛtirmūrdhvā paryāyāstasya coditāḥ || mṛgendre(-) tadekaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ manādi nibiḍaṃ mahat | pratyātmastha svakalāntā vāyuśakti samūhavat || svāyaṃbhuve(-) athānādi malaḥ puṃsāṃ paśutvaṃ parikīrtitam | tuṣakaṃdukavajjñeyaṃ māyābījāṃkurasya tat || ityādi | atha māyeya pāśamāha pauṣkare(-) mayatyasmājjagadviśvaṃ māyā tena samīritā| na ca māyā svarūpeṇa puṃsāṃ kāryakarī sthitā || kāryairaṇopakāritvādyadidaṃ tanna cātmanām | parākhye(-) prayoktrādi mahiprātametadaṇvartha sādhanam | pratyātma niyataṃ bhoga bhedatopyavasīyate || svāyaṃbhuve(-) evaṃ māyāṃ janastho'ṇurnijadoṣa tiraskṛtaḥ | yāti tanmayatāṃ teṣu māyā bhogeṣu rañjitaḥ || kāraṇe(-) tasya śuddhasya sambandhaṃ samāyāti śivātkalā | kalodbaccalita caitanyo vidyādarśita gocaraḥ || rāgeṇa rañjitaścātha pradhānena guṇātmanā | buddhyādi karaṇānīka saṃbandhādbadhyate paśuḥ || tato niyati saṃśleṣātsvārjite viniyamyate | kālena kāla saṃkhyāna kārya bho(bhā)ga vimohitaḥ || evaṃ tatva kalābaddhaḥ kiñcijjño dehasaṃyutaḥ | māyā bhoga pariṣvaktastanmayaḥ sahajāvṛtaḥ || śiva (***) duḥkhādi bhogaṃ bhuṅkte svakarmataḥ || atha karmapāśamāha(-) viśvasārottare(-) dharmādharmātmakaṃ karma tacca trividhamarthataḥ | jātyāyurbhogadaṃ yena nāmiśraṃ pacyate kvacit ||
kiraṇe(-) yathānādirmalastasya karmāpyevamanādikam | yadyanādi na saṃsiddhaṃ vaicitryaṃ kena hetunā || mṛgendre(-) karmavyāpārajanyatvādadṛṣṭaṃ sūkṣmabhāvataḥ | janakaṃ dhārakaṃ bhāgyamadhyātmādi trisādhanam || tatsavyānṛta yonitvāddharmādharma svarūpakam | svāpe vipākamabhyeti tatsraṣṭā (**) viyujyate || athādhvatraya lakṣaṇamāha(-) trayāṇāmadhvanāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ vakṣye iti | mataṅge(-) jalādīnāṃ guṇāntānāṃ tatvānāmuttarottaram | vṛddhirdaśaguṇā jñeyā bhūtatvācchatakoṭitaḥ || śatottara guṇāni syuḥ śeṣāṇyuktāni śāsane || māyāntāni tu tattvāni tebhyastatvaṃ sahastradhā | yāvat sadāśivaṃ tatvaṃ tatparaṃ lakṣasaṃjñikam || catuṣkaṃ śānti paryantamato meyaḥ paraśśivaḥ || tathā siddhāntasārāvalyām(-) kṣmātatvaṃ śatakoṭiyojanamapaḥ prārabhya goṇāntakaṃ paṃktyātadgaṇanā tathā prakṛtito māyāvasānaṃ śatam || sāhastraṃ ca sadāśivāvadhi (***) tyantakaṃ lakṣato vyāpyordhvaṃ parato'pyameyavibhavo bindoradhiṣṭhāyakaḥ || kāmike(-) śuddhādhvā baindavaḥ prokto malyena kaluṣātmanām | māyādi parataḥ prānto miśrādhvā malakarmiṇām || śuddhādhvā sakalānāṃ prakīrtitaḥ | kiraṇe(-) śuddhe'dhvani śivaḥ kartā proktonaṃtosite prabhuḥ|| pauṣkare(-) śrīkaṇṭho guṇatatvasthaḥ tadadho bhuvanādhipaḥ || ityādi| atha ca śabdāt saṃhāraśaktipā(vā)talakṣaṇe āha(-) mṛgendre(-) dvayorapyadhvanorevakrama prasava yoginoḥ | vilayaḥ pratilomyena śakti tatvadvayāvadhi || pauṣkare(-) tanmātreṣveva bhūtāni tanmātrāṇyahaṃ kṛtau| indriyāṇi manaścāpi buddhauvāsāṃ guṇeṣvapi ||
triguṇāḥ prakṛtau sāpi rāgādyaṃ tatvapañcakam | māyāyāṃ layamāyāti sā tu nityopapāditā || māyopari viśuddhādhvā bindau pralayamicchati | binduḥkalādi śaktyātmā śivādhiṣṭhitavigrahaḥ || nityamāste śivasyāsya viṣayātmatayāgrataḥ | punaḥ pravartate viśvaṃ jagadārabhyabindutaḥ || tathā tatvaprakāśe(-) māyāpuruṣaḥ śiva ityetattritayaṃ (*) rtthasaṃhāre | avaśiṣyate punastatpravartate pūrva tatsṛṣṭau || mṛgendre(-) svāpe'pyāste bodhayan bodhayogyān rodhyān rundhan vā(pā?)cayan karma kartā | māyāśaktirvyakti yogyāḥ prakurvan paśyan sarvaṃ yadyathā vastujātam || kāmike(-) sṛṣṭisaṃhārayoḥ kāle rodhaśaktiḥ śivātmikā | paśūnāṃ pakva pāśānāṃ muktihetoḥ patatyadhaḥ || atha śaktipātalakṣaṇamāha(-) mṛgendra(-) yeṣāṃ śarīriṇāṃ śaktiḥ patatyavinivṛttaye| teṣāṃ talliṅgamautsukāṃ muktau dveṣo bhavasthitau|| bhaktiśca śivabhakteṣu śraddhā tacchāsake vidhau || pauṣkare(-) karmanāśānmalasyāpi vipāke sahakāriṇaḥ | patatyunmīlinīśaktistadānugrahakāriṇī|| tasyāṃ patita mātrāyāṃ malasyādho niyāmikā| śaktirnivartate tasyāṃ nivṛttāyāṃ mahātmanām || vairāgyaṃ jāyate kṣipraṃ saṃsārādduḥkhasāgarāt | didṛkṣā jāyate śambhoḥ pādapaṅkajayorapi|| kathaṃ drakṣyāmi deveśaṃ mokṣye'haṃ bandhanāt katham | ko vā darśayitā śambhoriti sañjāyate matiḥ || evaṃ saṃsārato bhītamanugṛhṇāti ceśvaraḥ || ityādi vistarabhayānna likhitam || dīkṣāsametaḥ paripūtakāyo nyāsaissatatvaiḥ kamalaṃ vilikhya | pradarśya mudrāṃ nalinīṃ yajeta śrīpadmapīṭhasthitaliṅgamīśam ||
atha kriyāpāda ārabhyate(-) dīkṣeti | yajurvedopaniṣadi(-) ācāryaḥ pūrvarūpam | antevāsyuttararūpam | vidyāsandhiriti | siddhāntaśiromaṇau iti śuddhena śiṣyeṇa prārthitaḥ paramoguruḥ | śaktipātaṃ samālokya dīkṣayā yojayedamum || svāyaṃbhuve(-) tatvairebhirnibaddhātmā sarvadharmauśca saṃyutaḥ || nānyena śakyate moktuṃ muktā dīkṣāṃ śivātmikām || mataṅge(-) viśiṣṭaṃ dīyate jñānaṃ kṣīyate pāśasañcayaḥ | māyākarma malodbhūto yayā dīkṣeti sā matā|| siddhāntaśekhare(-) seyaṃ dīkṣā dvidhā bhinnā sādhārādhāra varjitā | ācārya mantareṇaiva kriyate śaṅkareṇa yā || vijñānā kalanāmnaśca pralayākala kasya ca | tīvraśaktinipātena dīkṣā sādhāravarjitāḥ || gurumūrtiṃ samāśritya mandaśakti nipātanāt | kurute sakalasyeśaḥ sādhārāntamimāṃ viduḥ || sādhārātrividhā proktā sa bījā bīja cihnayā | yathākramaṃ karmabhaktirjñānakāṇḍeṣu tāḥ sphuṭāḥ || sabījā dvividhā loka dharmiṇī śivadharmiṇī | adharmaṃ sañcitaṃ sarvaṃ karmagāmi viśodhyate || dharmāvaśeṣato yatra sā dīkṣā lokadharmiṇī || bhautikī naiṣṭhikī ceti dvidhā sā śivadharmiṇī || vratamokṣa samāyuktā bhautikīti nigadyate | śarīrapāta paryanta vratā sā nauṣṭhikī matā || atha nibījadīkṣāyā dvividho bhedo nigadyate | sadyo nirvāṇadātvādyā ciraṃ nirvāṇadā parā || prārabdha sañcitāgāmi karmajālaṃ viśodhyate | atitīvreṇa pākena śarīrādi jugupsatām || yayātyanta viraktānāṃ sadyo nirvāṇadā tu sā | prārabdhakarmaṇāṃ bhogādyayā muktimanantaram ||
yānti bālādayaḥ seyaṃ ciraṃ nirvāṇadā bhavet | cakṣuṣi sparśadīkṣā ca vāca(ci)kī mānasī tathā || śāstrī ca yogadīkṣeti ṣoḍhā sā tu prakīrtitā(rtyate) || cakṣurunmīlya yattattvaṃ dhyātvā śiṣyaṃ samīkṣate | pāśabandha vimokṣāya dīkṣeyaṃ cākṣuṣī bhavet || vidhāya dakṣiṇe haste śivaṃ brahmāṅga saṃyutam | saṃspṛśecchiṣyamūrdhni syātsparśadīkṣā bhavediyam || tatvecittaṃ samādhāya dyotiteśvara tejasā | uccaret saṃhitā mantrān vāgdīkṣeyaṃ prakīrtitā || mānasaṃ vidhimāśritya mānasītyabhidhīyate || śāstrasya saṃpradānena śāstradīkṣā samīritā | tatvadyota (**) gasya pradānādyogajā bhavet || ājñādīkṣādi bhedena sā punaḥ saptadhā bhavet | ājñopamā svastikā ca kalaśasnapanā parā || vibhūti paṭṭāyatte ca svāyattā saptakīrtitāḥ | gurvājñāpālane dakṣā yā sā jñeti prakīrtitā || pūrveṣāṃ samayācāra sadṛśā copamā matā | āropya svastikāṃ śiṣyaṃ gurorakṣiṇakarmaṇā | svastikā kalaśasnānādabhiṣekā hvayā ca sā || bhūti paṭṭa mayī dīkṣā bhasmanā yā prakīrtitā | śiṣyasya phāle gurūṇā samayācāra mārgataḥ || ācāryo liṅgamādāya samabhyarcya yathāvidhi | śiṣyasyālokanaṃ samyagāyattaṃ parikīrtitam || prahvī bhūya tataḥ śiṣyo liṅgaṃ svīkṛtya bhaktitaḥ | guroḥ svāyattamityuktaṃ svottamāṅgādi dhāraṇam || bhedopabhedasaṃyuktā sā punardvividhā bhavet | tayorjñānavatī cādyā dvitīyā ca kriyāvatī ||
ādyā viśiṣṭajñānādi yuktena manasā kṛtiḥ | viśiṣṭamalapākasya kriyate guruṇaiva sā || anyā kriyāvatī kuṇḍa maṇḍalādi sametayā | bhedopabhedasaṃyuktā nirbijā parikīrtitā || jñānopadeśinī dīkṣā cinmayī parikīrtitā || sādhāraivaṃ bahuvidhā saṃkṣepāt samudīritā | mṛgendre(-) dīkṣānala spṛṣṭamalasya(ssa ?) jantosvākyaṃ balaṃ vyaktimupaiti yogāt | śaktyāvibhoścumbita hṛtpradeśaṃ nānyena puṃsā vinivṛttireti || ityādi vistarabhayānnalikhitam || itthaṃ dīkṣā sametaḥ satatvairnyāsaiḥ paripūtakāyassan atha tatvanyāsamāha raurave(-) śivatatvaṃ śaktitatvaṃ mastake vinyasedguruḥ || sadā śiveśvaraṃ tatvaṃ dvayaṃ vakteṣu vinyaset || vidyāñca mohinīṃ caiva kālaṃ caiva kalāṃ tathā | avidyāṃ niyatiṃ caiva rāgañca hṛdaye nyaset | puruṣaṃ prakṛtiṃ caiva buddhyahaṅkārameva ca | manaḥ śrotraṃ tvacaṃ netraṃ jihvāṃ prāṇaṃ tathaiva ca | vācaṃ pā(vā)ṇiṃ tathā pādaṃ gudañcopasthameva ca || śabdaṃ sparśaṃ ca rūpañca rasaṃ gandhaṃ tathaiva ca | ākāśaṃ vāyumanalaṃ jalaṃ guhye tu vinyaset || pṛthivītatvamekantu pādayugme'pi vinyaset | ṣaṭtriṃśatattvavinyāsa uktaḥ śaivāgamoditaḥ || pṛthivyādini tatvāni bhogasthānāni dehinām | bhuvanaiḥ saha śodhyāni kramayuktyā yathā tathā|| ityādi | atha padmamaṇḍalamāha(-) kamalaṃ vilikhyeti || kāraṇe(-) atha vakṣye suraśreṣṭha padmamaṇḍala lakṣaṇam | caturoṣṭau ṣoḍaśa ca dvātriṃśacca tadārlli(ṃ)khet | śaktyagni śaśi sūryāṇāṃ vimbāntatra kramālli(ṃ)khet | guruktyā tatsvarūpañca jñātvā tatra śivaṃ yajet || ityādi |
atha padmamudrāmāha(-) nalinīṃ mudrāṃ pradarśyeti | kāraṇe(-) mocayatvakhilaṃ bandhaṃ śaivaṃ drāvayate drutam| mṛ (?) mocanāddrāvaṇāccaiṣā śaktirmudreti gīyate || maṇibandha samau hastā(tau?) ūrdhvāyāṃguṣṭhayojite || kiñcidākuñcitau kāryā madhyeṅguṣṭhau niyojitau || āsanādau prayoktavyā padmamudreyamīritā | uddhṛtāṅguṣṭhakāmuṣṭi vāmāṃguṣṭhāgragarbhiṇī || sā syādvāmāṅgulī guptā liṅgamudrā śiva priyā | vidhi saṃpūraṇī hyeṣā dharmādharma vināśinī || dīkṣāyāṃ viniyukteyaṃ pūjākāle prayojayet || ityādi | atha padmapīṭhasvarūpamāha(-) śrīpadmapīṭhasthitaliṅgamīśaṃ yajedi(te)ti | kāmike(-) karṇikā śivatatvaṃ ca kiñjalkāḥ śivatatvagāḥ | sadā śiveśvare tatve ājñācakra sthite dale | vidyāvṛntaṃ ca māyādi narāntaṃ nālamīritam || pṛthivyādi jalāntaṃ ca kandaṃ pṛthvī saraḥsmṛtam || yadājñācakramuditaṃ tadaṣṭadala sārasam | tatra sūryendu dahana śaktimaṇḍalagaḥ śivaḥ || pauṣkare(-) gurupadeśa mārgeṇa smṛtirāvāhanaṃ matam | sthireṇa manasā bhaktyā lakṣamūrti niveśanam | ārādhakena devasya yadetatsthāpanaṃ matam | tvadīyo'hamanugrāhyaḥ sthātavyaṃ bhavatā prabho | ārādhakasya bhāvo'yaṃ sannidhānaṃ budhaiḥ smṛtam || matprāṇāvadhiratreśa na gantavyaṃ tvayānyataḥ | gṛhāṇa paramāṃ pūjāmityetatsannirodhanam || apakvapāśabaddheṣu dīkṣādī na nareṣvapi | śrīkaṇṭhasyā prakāśeyaṃ kathitaṃ hyavakuṇṭhanam || dhyātvā hṛtpaṃkaje devaṃ vakṣyamāṇamathā yajet || ityādi vistara bhayānna likhitam |
bhakto maheśaḥ parama prasādī suprāṇaliṅgī śaraṇaḥ śivaikyaḥ | ādhāra padmaprabhṛti prasiddhamācāraliṃgādikamarcayantām || atha caryāpāda ārabhyate | bhakta iti | bhaktyādyaikyāntāḥ ṣaṭsthalajñāninaḥ ādhārādyājñānta ṣaṭkamalaprasiddhācārādi mahāliṅgāni arcayantām | tathā haṃsopaniṣadi(-) gudamavaṣṭabhyādhārādvāyumutthāpya svādhiṣṭhānaṃ triḥ pradakṣiṇī kṛtya maṇipūrakaṃ gatvā anāhata matikramya viśuddhau prāṇānnirudhyājñāmanuyāyya brahmarandhraṃ dhyāyan trimātrohamiti sarvadā dhyāyet | tathā yogaśatake(-) ādhāre liṅga nābhau hṛdaya sarasije tālu mule lalāṭe dve patre ṣoḍaśāre dvidaśadale dvādaśārdhe catuṣke | vāsānte bā(phā)lamadhye ḍa pha ka ṭha sahite deśe svarāṇāṃ madhye haṃsaṃ sudīptaṃ sakaladalayutaṃ varṇarūpaṃ namāmi || rna ācāre divyaliṅge nirūpama nijabhaktasthalāṃgaika bhāji dhrāṇāsye cittahaste na ca ghana sukhahetau kriyāśakti yukte | ghrāta (....) ya dravyamapyarpaṇaviṣaya vidhānopadiṣṭaṃ samarpya prāyaḥ sadbhakti pūrṇaḥ svayamayamiha gandha prasādaṃ bhajeta|| svāṅge māheśvarātmanyanupama sahajajñāna śakti prayukte jihvāsye suprasiddhe paratara guruliṅgābhidhe saṃsthite'smin | niṣṭhā bhakti prabhāva praṇihita sumahadbuddhi hastena vidvān rasyaṃ dravyaṃ samarpya svayamamalarasākhyaṃ prasādaṃ bhajeta || yo'sau nityaprasādī sthala parama(...)ḍa prāpta divyāṅga bhāji svecchāśakti prayukte dṛśi jagati mukhe pāṇināhaṃ kṛtena | sākṣālliṅge śivākhye savinayamavadhānātmatā bhaktiyukto draṣṭavyāṃśaṃ samarpyārpaṇa vinihita rūpa prasādaṃ bhajeta || saṃsakta prāṇaliṅga sthala vihita nijāṅge manaḥ praṇā(ṇe) nānā(-) liṅge cāsmiṃścarākhye tvaci jagati mukhetyādī śakti prayukte |
spraṣṭavyaṃ cārpayitvā svayamanubhava bhakti prabhāvopapanno nityaṃ sparśa prasādaṃ niratiśaya sukhaṃ tatvavettā bhajeta || liṅge sākṣātprasāde vimalaśaraṇa saṃjñāṅga saṃsthepi cāsmi(-) ñchrotavyaṃ śrotravaktre nikhilamiha parāśaktiyukte samarpya | ānandākāra bhaktiḥ sphuratara paramajñāna hastena soyaṃ śabdākhyaṃ tatprasādaṃ svayamaviratamatyāśrayastho bhajeta || aikyāṅge bhāji liṅge mahati hṛdi mukhe cinmahāśaktiyukte nityaṃ bhāvena hastena ca samarasa bhaktiḥ svayaṃ saccidātmā | jñātavyaṃ cārpayitvā vimalamatiravaśyaṃ samarpyārpaṇīyaṃ tasmāllabdhaṃ viśuddhaṃ ghanatara pariṇāma prasādaṃ bhajeta || ityādi |
athāntaḥpūjāmāha(-) siddhāntaśiromaṇau(-) buddhīndriya navadvāre bodhadīpe hṛdālaye | padmapīṭhasamāsīnaṃ cilliṅgaṃ śivavigraham || bhāvayitvā sadākālaṃ pūjayedbhāva vastubhiḥ | kṣamābhiṣeka salilaṃ viveko vastramucyate || satyamābharaṇaṃ proktaṃ vairāgyaṃ puṣpamālikā | gandhaḥ samādhi saṃpattiḥ akṣatāni ahaṃkriyā || śraddhādhūpo mahājñānaṃ jagadbhāsi pradīpikā | bhrāntimūla prapañcasya naivedyaṃ tannivedanam || maunaṃ ghaṇṭā parispandaḥ tāmbūlaṃ viṣayārpaṇam | viṣaya bhrāntirāhityaṃ tatpradakṣiṇa kalpanā || buddhestādātmikā śaktirnamaskāra kriyāmatā | evaṃvidhairbhāvasiddhairupacārairadūṣitaiḥ || pratyaṅ mukhamanābhūtvā pūjayelliṅgamāntare || vātūlottare(-) na kriyārahitaṃ jñānaṃ na jñāna rahitā kriyā | apaśyannandhako dagdhaḥ paśyanpaṅguśca dahyate ||

aṇḍaṃ hiraṇmayaṃ madhye samudraṃ rudrasya vīryātprathamaṃ babhūva | aṇḍādviṣṇurbrahmā jātavedāśca tanme manaḥ śivasaṃkalpamastu || tathā laiṅge(-) sauvarṇamabhavaccāṇḍaṃ māveṣṭyādyaṃ tadakṣaram | anekābdaṃ tathā cāpsu divyamaṇḍaṃ vyavasthitam || tasmādaṇḍādbabhūvādau viṣṇurbrahmā hutāśanaḥ || ityādi | athāṇḍajananasya śambhoḥ suvarṇa varṇatvamāha(-) hiraṇyeti | yadyasmātkāraṇāt śrutayaḥ hiraṇyagarbhādika tātaṃ brahmādi janakamīśaṃ suvarṇavarṇaṃ vadanti | taduktaṃ nārāyaṇopaniṣadi(-) namo hiraṇyabāhave hiraṇyavarṇāya hiraṇyarūpāya hiraṇyapataye'mbikāpataye umāpataye paśupataye namo nama iti || tathā tātparyasaṃgrahe(-) ukto hiraṇyapatireṣa hiraṇyabāhuruktoṃmbikā patirumāpatireṣa uktaḥ | ityādi | aṣṭau padāṣṭā pada bījarūpau yadbījavṛkṣau jagadeka pūjyau| tadarcitaṃ cācyuta mukhyadevaiḥ rudrasya liṅgaṃ jagadālayaṃ hi || śikhihemabījam | atha harabīja tadbījayorabhedamāha(-) aṣṭeti | bījavṛkṣau aṣṭāpadāṣṭāpada bījarūpau | hiraṇya hiraṇya retasau yadyasmātkāraṇāt jagadeka pūjyau tataḥ acyuta mukhya devaiḥ | tadukta mṛgvede(-) omagnimīle purohitam| yajuṣi(-) vahni mukhā vai devāḥ || sāmni(-) etamevātmānaṃ vaiśvānaramupāste | atharva śirasi(-) yo vai rudraḥ sabhagavānyaścāgnistasmai namo namaḥ | tathā puruṣārtha sudhānidhau(-) guruvarhnirdvijātīnāṃ sarveṣāṃ brāhmaṇo guruḥ | gurureva patiḥ strīṇāṃ sarvasyābhyāgato guruḥ || ityādi | atha vittamahatvamāha(-) ṛgvede pipiro hiraṇyaiḥ | śivadharmottare(-) jñānavṛddhā vayovṛddhāstapovṛddhā bahuśrutāḥ |
ityete dhanavṛddhasya dvāre tiṣṭhanti kiṅkarāḥ || tathā skānde(-) vittena hīnaṃ puruṣaṃ tyajanti dārāśca mitrāṇi sahodarāśca | taṃ vittavantaṃ punareva yānti vittaṃ hi loke puruṣasya daivam || tathā bhartṛhariḥ (-) yasyāsti vittaṃ sa naraḥ kulīnaḥ sa paṇḍitaḥ sa śrutavān guṇajñaḥ | sa eva vaktā sa ca darśanīyaḥ sarve guṇāḥ kāñcanamāśrayanti || ityādi | hiraṇya hiraṇyaretasormahatvaṃ sakalalokaprasiddham | kṛśānuretāḥ sarvajño hiraṇyaretāhuta bhugubhayatrāpyamaraḥ tattasmātkāraṇāt acyuta mukhyadevaiḥ nārāyaṇa prabhṛtibhiḥ śikhi hemabījaṃ hiraṇya hiraṇyaretasornidānaṃ rudrasya liṅgaṃ arcitam (tathā ca nairuktaḥ(-) he rudra) taduktaṃ mṛgendre(-) tava śriye maruto mardayantaḥ rudra yattejanimacāru citram| tathā ca nairuktaḥ(-) he rudra parameśāna cārvatyanta śobhanaṃ tathā citraṃ cāyanīyaṃ pūjanīyamiti smṛtam | yattejanima liṅgaṃ yattava tanmarutaḥ surāḥ | viṣṇvādayaḥ śriye svasvapadaprāptyarthamādarāt || mardayantassvīyahasta sparśa pūrvaṃ yajanti hi|| tathā vyāsāṣṭake(-) sarvasya pūjārhamihottamāṅgaṃ saṃpūjyate liṅgavaraṃ harasya | anena paryāptamatīva mūḍhāḥ prabhuryathevecchati tatkaroti || brahmātra liṅge hariratra jātaḥ surāsurāścedamihārcayanti | tathāpi mūḍhā na vicārayanti ko vādhiko'pyasti samoharasya || navaja cakrāṅka saroruhāṅkaṃ liṅgāṅkitaṃ paśya jaga jagadbhagāṅkam | hasta prabaddhe sati kaṃkaṇe tu paśyanti mūḍhāḥ khalu darpaṇena || tathā laiṅge(-) śivastriliṅgamakhilaṃ devi prakṛtirmama dehajā|| pulliṅgaṃ puruṣo viśvo mama deha samudbhavaḥ || ubhābhyāmeva vai sṛṣṭirlokānāṃ tu na saṃśayaḥ
ityādi || 4 || vidanti vedāḥ śivapādacihnaṃ śiveti vācaṃ vadatāntyajena | bhuñjīta sākaṃ śrutirāha satyaṃ kṛtantvidaṃ vīraṇadeśikendraiḥ || atha śiva śabdoccāraṇa phalaṃ vedavedya śivasvarūpaṃ cāha(-) vindantīti | śiveti vācaṃ vadatā antyajena sākaṃ sahabhuñjīteti śrutiḥ satyamāha | tathā sāmavede(-) api vā yaścaṇḍālaḥ śiveti vācaṃ vadettena sahasaṃvasettena sahabhuñjīta tena sahabhuñjīteti | tathā skānde(-) devāḥ ṣoḍaśa lakṣāṇi navalakṣāṇi mānuṣāḥ | daśabhirdaśabhistadvajjalajā vihagā mṛgāḥ | sarīsṛpāstu lakṣaṇi ekādaśa ca sthāvarā || aṣṭau ca daśa lakṣāṇi saptajanmānyamūni vai || śiveti maṅgalaṃ nāma yasya vāci pravartate | saptajanmakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ bhasmī bhavati tasya vai || vasettena viśettena sākaṃ tena vadetsaha | tena sārdhaṃ tu bhuñjīta bhuñjīta śrutirāha hi || ityādi | atha vedamahimānamāha(-) vedāḥ śivapādacihnaṃ vindanti | taduktaṃ kaṭhavalyupaniṣadi(-) śarve vedā yatpadamāmananti tapāṃsi sarvāṇi ca yadvadanti | yadicchanto brahmacaryaṃ caranti tatte padaṃ saṃgraheṇa brabrabīmihyomityetat || tathādityapurāṇe(-) vedā acuḥ(-) na jānanti paraṃ bhāvaṃ yasya brahmādayaḥ surāḥ | adyāpi na vayaṃ vidmaḥ sa deva tripurāntakaḥ || śrṛṇvantu devatāḥ sarvāḥ satyamasmatparaṃ vacaḥ | nāsti rudrānmahādevādadhikaṃ daivataṃ param | na yathā kūrma romāṇi śrṛṅgañca nara mastake | na yathāsti viyatpuṣpaṃ na tathāsti harātparaḥ || ityādi |
īśvara uvāca(-) matprasādādbhaviṣyadhvaṃ he vedā lokapūjitāḥ | yuṣmānāśritya viprendrā karma kurvantu nānyathā || ye vai yuṣmānanādṛtya śāstraṃ kurvanti mānavāḥ | niraye te vipacyante yāvadindrāścaturdaśa || śreyase triṣulokeṣu na vedādadhikaṃ param | vidyate nātra sandehaḥ iti dattovaro mayā || ityādi vistarabhayānna likhitam || idantu śivarahasya pañcaratnaṃ vīraṇadeśikendraiḥ śrīmatsosali vīraṇārādhyanāmācārya sārvabhaumaiḥ kṛtaṃ viracitam || śrīḥ śrīḥ śrīḥ | vāraṇārādhyaśiṣya śrīrevaṇārādhyanirmitā || vyākhyā śrīpañcaratnasya śivatatvaprakāśikā || śrīḥ || || [iti śrīmadvedavedaśiraḥ śivāgamapurāṇa prabhṛti pracuraśāstrapravīṇa śrīmatsosalivīraṇārādhyadeśika kuñjarasya kṛteḥ śivarahasya pañcaratnasya vyākhyā revaṇārādhya viracitā śivatatvaprakāśikā parisamāptā] || || śrīśivāya namaḥ||
śrutyarthaprakāśikā || śivāya namaḥ|| śruti śruti śiroratna gāyatrī śirasi sthitam | agnimī(?)e payojyotiratārakaṃ bhavatārakam || vande sarveśvarācārya sārvabhauma tanūbhavam | sosalīvīraṇārādhyaṃ lokārādhyaṃ yamīśvaram || revaṇārādhyanāmāhaṃ kurve śrutyartha dīpikām | śruti śruti śiroratna pañcaratnasya pañcikām || ṛgvede vedya pavata iti manausarvagīrvāṇatāta(-) māvo rājāna mantre suranaragaṇa pūjyaṃ yajurveda vedyaḥ(dye?) | taṃ deveṣvākhya mantre vidhu vidhiṣu varaṃ sāmaveda prapadya(-) īśānādāvaparva śruti caramamago cintyamenaṃ namāmi || tatra tāvadācāryaḥ śrutisāra pañcaratnasyāsya śrutyartha prakāśikā vyākhyāṃ saṃkṣepataścikīrṣuḥ prathamaṃ śrutyartha sādhanaṃ purāṇamiti darśayati | skānde sūtasaṃhitāyām(-) yaścaturvedavidvipraḥ purāṇaṃ vetti nārthataḥ | taṃ dṛṣṭvā bhayamāpnoti vedo māṃ pratariṣyati || tathā śaive vāyavīyasaṃhitāyām(-) yo vindyāccaturo vedā sāṅgopaniṣado dvijaḥ | na cetpurāṇaṃ sañcintya naiva sasyādvicakṣaṇaḥ || tathā mahābhārate(-) purāṇaireva vedārtho vi (**) jñāyate khalu | bibheti mānavādvedaḥ purāṇābhyāsa varjitāt || itihāsapurāṇābhyāṃ vedaṃ samupabṛṃhayet || bibhetyalpaśrutādvedo māmayaṃ pratariṣyati || tathā tātparyasaṃgrahe(-) vedārthanirṇayavidhau hi purāṇamaṅgaṃ nirṇīta vedaviṣayāḥ smṛtayo bhavanti | ārṣaḥ śruteriva purāṇa giraḥ sakāśe
nālaṃ prakāśayitumātmabalāvalepam || ato'sya śrutisāra pañcaratnasya śrutyarthaprakāśikākhyā vyākhyā purāṇaprabhṛtibhireva karaṇīyetyayamāśayaḥ | atha tatra bhavān atra revaṇācāryo nirvighna parisamāptyarthañcaturveda stotra pātramīśvaraṃ namaskurute | taduktamalaṃkāra sarvasve(-) āśīrnamaskriyā vastu nirdeśo vāpi tanmukham | iti | atha parameśvaraḥ sarvadevatā janaka iti ṛgvede darśayati(-) ṛgiti | ṛgvede(-) vedyasomaḥ pavata iti | manau jñātavyaḥ somaḥ pavata iti pratīkamavati mantre sarvagīrvāṇatātaṃ viṣṇvādi samastadevatā janakam | taduktamṛgvede(-) somaḥ pavate janitā matīnāṃ janitā divo janitā pṛthivyāḥ janitāgnerjanitā sūryasya janitendrasya janitātha viṣṇoḥ | tathā cādityapurāṇe(-) umayā sahito devaḥ soma ityucyate budhaiḥ | sa eva kāraṇaṃ nānyo viṣṇorapi ca vai śrutiḥ || tathā kāśīkhaṇḍe(-) matīnāñca devaḥ pṛthivyā vahneḥ sūryasya vajriṇaḥ | sākṣādapi ca viṣṇorvai somo janayiteśvaraḥ || tathā kālikākhaṇḍe(-) dyāvāpṛthivyorindrāgnyoḥ dhiyāṃ viṣṇoryamasya ca | varuṇasya śaśāṃkasya janitā parameśvaraḥ || tathā laiṅge(-) somaṃ sasarja yajñārthaṃ somād dyauḥ samajāyata | dharā ca vahniḥ sūryaśca vajrapāṇiḥ śacīpatiḥ || viṣṇurnārāyaṇaḥ śrīmānsarvaṃ somamayaṃ jagat || tathā tātparyasaṃgrahe (-) some latātmani maheśvara gauṇavṛttyā viṣṇoravādi janakatvamṛcā kayāpi | tvayyeva tadbhavitu marhati mukhyavṛttyā nendrena paṅkaja bhave nitarāṃ murārau ||

granthapātaḥ (**) niyamiti smṛtam | yattejasimalliṅgaṃ yattava tanmarutaḥ surāḥ | viṣṇvādayaḥ śriye svasvapadaprāptyarthamādarāt || mardayanta svīya hastasparśa pūrvaṃ yajanti hi || ityādi | vistarabhayānna likhitam || atha sāmavedaprapadamantre śivasya brāhmaṇyaṃ darśayati(-) tvamiti | sāmaveda prapadye | prapada saṃjñāmarhatīti daṇḍādibhyoya iti ya pratyayaḥ | athavā prapūrvāt padḷgatāviti dhātoḥ sarvegatyarthā dhātavo jñānārthā iti bhāṣya vacanāt | sāmaveda jñātavye vā tvaṃ deveṣvākhyābhidhānaṃ yasya tasminmantre | vidha (***) daśāvatārarūpā viṣṇavaḥ | vidhayo navabrahmāṇaḥ teṣu varaṃ śreṣṭham | taduktaṃ skānde(-) viṣṇusaṃkhyā hyasaṃkhyātā hyasaṃkhyātāḥ pitāmahāḥ | asaṃkhyātāḥ surendrāśca nitya eko maheśvaraḥ || ato vidhu vidhiṣviti bahuvacana prayogaḥ kṛtaḥ | vidhuḥ śrīvatsalāñchanaḥ viśvasṛḍvidhirubhayatrāpyamaraḥ | taduktaṃ sāmavedaprapadamantre(-) tvaṃ deveṣu brāhmaṇosyahaṃ manuṣyeṣu | brāhmaṇo vai brāhmaṇamupadhāvatyupatvā dhāvāmi || tathā parāśarapurāṇe(-) tato viprasya saṃbandhaḥ śivasyaiva hi yujyate| saṅkarāḥ sarvadevāśca vṛṣalastu purandaraḥ || pitāmahastu vaiśyaśca kṣatriyaḥ paramo hariḥ | brāhmaṇo bhagavān rudraḥ sarveṣāmuttamottamaḥ ||
brahmabhāvo hi rudrasya brāhmaṇyaṃ naiva hetujam || brāhmaṇo vai sadāḥ (**) ke brāhmaṇonupadhāvati | mahābrāhmaṇamīśānamupadhāvenna cetaram || tathā mānavapurāṇe(-) rudra eva sadā sākṣādbrahmaṇo brahma bhāvataḥ | brāhmaṇaḥ paṭhitastasmādbrāhmaṇo rudra eva vai || prajānāṃ pālako rājā viṣṇuḥ sarvasya pālakaḥ | tena rājā haristasya brāhmaṇyaṃ tvaupacārikam || jagadvistaraṇe naiva kāryeṇa bhagavānajaḥ | kevalaṃ vaiśya evasyānna rājāna dvijottamaḥ || brāhmaṇa kṣatriya viśo rudra viṣṇu pitā mahāḥ | tatsevā tatparaḥ śūdraḥ indraḥ sāmaśrutiḥ khalu || tathā skānde(-) brāhmaṇo bhagavān rudraḥ kṣatriyo viṣṇurucyate | brahmāvaiśyastathā prokto vāsavaḥ śūdra ucyate || tathā tātparyasaṃgrahe(-) tvaṃ brāhmaṇastvadupadhāvanameva kāryaṃ na brāhmaṇaistvaditare na bhavantyupāsyāḥ | na brāhmaṇā na varavarṇaniṣevaṇena saṃbhāvayema (*****) naḥ prapadaṃ pramāṇam || punastameva śrutyarthaṃ prakaṭayati yajurvede | yo vai svāṃ devatāṃ ati yajate prasvāyai devatāyaiccavate na parāṃ prāpnoti | pāpīyān bhavati | tathā ca nairuktaḥ(-) asyārthaḥ kathyate vipro(prā) yastu svāṃ devatāṃ śivam | (***) kramya yajate pūjayatyanya devatām || sa hi pracyavate svīya devatāyai narādhamaḥ | bhūtvā parādhīna parāṃ prāpnoti gatimuttamām || na gacchatyatha pāpīyānati pāpī bhaveddhruvam | tathā vīrāgame(-) brāhmaṇānāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ śiva evādhi daivatam | viṣṇusaṃsmaraṇādeva brahmatvaṃ naiva vidyate ||
śivaṃ visṛjya deveśaṃ viṣṇumārādhayeddvijaḥ | pāyasānnaṃ visṛjyātha śunyucchiṣṭaṃ ca bhakṣyet || ityādi | vistara bhayānna likhitam | athātharvaṇavede śivetara devatā parityāgamāha(-) īśāneti | śa (*****) dīryasya tasminnatharva śruti caramamanau atharvaśikhopaniṣanmantre cintyaṃ dhyeyaṃ eva enañcaturvedastotrapātraṃ śivaṃ namāmi vande | ahamiti śeṣaḥ | tathātharvaśikhāyām(-) īśānaḥ śiva eko dhyeyaḥ śivaṅkaraḥ sarvamanyatparityajya samāptātharvaśikhā etāmadhītyadvijo garbhavāsādvimukto vimucyata ityoṃ satyam | tathā vyāsaviṣṇu saṃvāde(-) viṣṇuḥ(-) gacchatvaṃ śaraṇaṃ devaṃ sarvabhāvena śaṅkaram | santyajya tṛṇavaddevān brahmaviṣṇvādikāṃstathā | yo mahādevamanyena hīnadaivena durmatiḥ | sakṛtsādhāraṇaṃ brūte so'ntyajonāntyajontyajaḥ || kartāhaṃ sarvajagatāṃ mama kartā maheśvaraḥ | tasya devādhidevasya kartā ko'pi na vidyate || atra me vacanaṃ vyāsa śrṛṇu mūrkha yathārthavat | yacchrutvā sarvabhūtānāṃ śiva eva bhavenmatiḥ|| kimatra bahunoktena śivaṃ dhyāyecchivaṅkaram | śivādanyatparityajya daivataṃ bhuktimuktaye|| sarvavedaśikhātharvaśikhā prāpyaivameva hi | tathā brahmagītāyām(-) brahmāviṣṇubhaktyā ca madbhaktyā nāsti nāsti parā gatiḥ || (bhagavadgītāyām(-) īśvaraḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ hṛddeśe'rjuna tiṣṭhati | bhrāmayan sarvabhūtāni yantrārūḍhāni māyayā ||) śaṃbhu bhaktyaiva sarveṣāṃ satyameva mayoditam | ataḥ sarvaṃ parityajya śivādanyattu daivatam ||
tameva śaraṇaṃ gacchetsadyo muktiṃ yadīthati| ayameva hi vedārtho nāparaḥ para māstikāḥ|| anyathā cetsurakassatyaṃ mūrdhā me'tra patiṣyati| ayameva hi satyārtho nāparaḥ paramāsthikāḥ|| viśvāsārthaṃ śivaṃ spṛṣṭvā trirvaḥ śapathayāmyaham|| tasmāddevo ditohyarthaḥ satyaṃ satyaṃ mayoditam| gṛhṇāmi paraśuṃ taptaṃ satyameva na saṃśayaḥ|| anyathā vedavākyānāmartha ityabhi śaṅkayā| aniścitārthāścenmūrdhā yuṣmāko ca patiṣyati|| satyameva mayā proktaṃ śambhoḥ pādau praśāmyaham|| sadā sa eva siddhāntaḥ pūrvapakṣāstathā pare|| tathā śaive vāyavīyasaṃhitāyāmupamanyuḥ(-) sarvānyatparityajya śiva eva śivaṅkaraḥ| parodhyeyo'tha deveśaḥ samāptātharviṇī śrutiḥ|| tathā cāditya purāṇe raviḥ(-) mumukṣubhiḥ sadādhyeyaḥ śiva eva nirañjanaḥ| sarvamanyatparityajya dhyāyannevaṃ vimucyate|| tathā mānavapurāṇe manuḥ(-) ato mumukṣubhissevyaḥ sāmbaḥ sarveśvarā hvayaḥ| sarvamanyatparityajyetyāha cātharvaṇa śrutiḥ|| parāśara purāṇe(-)parāśaraḥ(-) sarvamanyatparityajya śiva eva śivaṅkaraḥ| dhyeya ityāha paramā śrutirātharvaṇapa khalu|| tathā sūtasaṃhitāyāṃ vyāsaḥ(-) ato mumukṣubhiḥ prājñaiḥ śiva eva śivaṅkaraḥ| dhyeyaḥ sarvaṃ parityajya śivādanyattu daivatam|| asminnarthe śrutiḥ sādhvī samāptā veda vittamāḥ|| tathā sūtagītāyāṃ sūtaḥ(-)
satyaṃ satyaṃ punassatyamuddhṛtya bhujamucyate| prasādādeva sarveṣāṃ sarvasiddhirmaheśituḥ|| ato'pi sa śivodhyeyaḥ prādhānyena śivaṅkaraḥ| sarvamanyatparityajya daivataṃ parameśvarāt|| śikhā cātharvaṇapa sādhvī sarvavedottamottamā| asminnarthe samāptā sā śrutayaścāparā api|| tathā ca caturveda tātparyasaṃgrahe haradattācāryaḥ(-) brahmādikaṃ sakalamanyadapohya puṃsāṃ dhyātavyamekamabhidhāya śivaṅkara tvām| vaktavyamanyadanapekṣa vimokṣahetu mātharvaṇaḥ parisamāptimuvāca vedaḥ|| punastameva śrutyarthaṃ prakaṭayati śvetāśvataropaniṣadi(-) viśvādhiko rudro maharṣiḥ hiraṇya garbhaṃ janayāmāsapūrvam| sa no buddhyā śubhayā saṃyunaktu|| tathā sūtasaṃhitāyām(-) tato viśvādhikaṃ rudraṃ maharṣiṃ sarva sākṣiṇam| brahmaviṣṇvādayo devāḥ pūjayāmāsurādarāt|| tathā mānava purāṇe(-) rudraṃ viśvādhikaṃ sākṣāt maharṣiṃ satatoditam| hiraṇyagarbhasaṃjñasya devasya janakaṃ tathā|| brahma viṣṇvādayo devāḥ pūjayanti sadāśivam|| ityādi| pratiṣedhamukhenāpi doṣamāha(-) śvetāśvataropaniṣadi(-) yathācarmavadākāśaṃ veṣṭayanti mānavīḥ| tathā śivamavijñāya duḥkhasyānto bhaviṣyati| parāśara purāṇe(-) vihāya sāmbamīśānaṃ yajante devatāntaram| te mahāghora saṃsāre patanti parimohitāḥ|| tathā saurasaṃhitāyām(-) śivamekaṃ parityajya yo'nyadaivamupāsate| tṛṣito jāhnavī tīre kūpaṃ khanati durmatiḥ|| sarvān devān parityajya yajetpañcāsyamīśvaram||
sarvān mantrān parityajya japetpañcākṣarī manum|| tathaiva ṛgvede bhasma jābālopaniṣacchirasi atharvaṇi| rudrākṣa jābālopaniṣacchirasi vedavākyaṃ veditavyam| grantha vistarabhayānna likhitam|| atra svabhāvoktiralaṅkāraḥ| taduktaṃ pratāparudrīye(-) svabhāvoktirasau cāru cathā vadvastu varṇanam| vṛttamapi sragdharā nāmakam| taduktaṃ vṛttaratnākare(-) mrabhnairyānāṃ trayeṇa trimuniyati yutā sragdharā kīrtiteyam|| iti|| bhasmadhyānācchrutiḥ śrī bhasita guṇagaṇaṃ bhasmajābālakīyā tadrudrākṣaṃ trayīyākṣamaṇi phalagaṇaṃ sākṣājjābālakī sā| raudrī pañcākṣarī śrī śiva janima dhṛtiṃ sevyatīrtha prasādā(-) suktvā jābālaśākhā jayati tu jagatāṃ dīpikāṃtāṃ namāmi|| itthaṃ caturvedastotra pātramīśvaraṃ praṇamyedānīṃ bhasmarudrākṣa pañcākṣara śivaliṅgadhāraṇa śivapāda tīrtha śiva prasāda pratipādakānāṃ śruti śirasāṃ namaskāramāha(-) bhasmeti| bhasma jābālakī ṛgveda bhasma jābālopaniṣatsaṃbandhinīyā śrutirasti bhasmadhyānātpratīkavatī sā śrutiḥ śrī bhasita guṇagaṇaṃ śrīmadbhasmaguṇa samūhamuktvā jayati sarvotkarṣeṇa vartate| jagatāṃ dīpikāṃ jagatprakāśakāṃ tāṃ bhasma jābālopaniṣadaṃ namāmi| taduktamṛgvede bhasma jābālopaniṣadi (-) bhasmadhyānādīśvaradhyāno bhavati| bhasma dhyānāt pañcākṣarī smaraṇo bhavati| bhasma dhyānāt sthāṇutvaṃ ca gacchati| sa eva bhasma jyotiḥ sa eva bhasma jyotiḥ| vibhatiḥ| vibhūti dhāraṇadbrahyaikatvaṃ gacchati| sa eva bhasma jyotiḥ sa eva bhasma jyotiḥ| vibhūti dhāraṇāt devā mṛtatvaṃ ca gacchati| sa eva bhasma jyotiḥ| sa(-)
eṣa bhasma jyotiḥ| bhasma mananādeva pāpaṃ bhasmasāt karoti| bhasma mananādeva kilikiñcatadvidīni vinaśyati| bhasma mananādeva saṃsārottaraṇaṃ karoti| sa eṣa bhasma jyotiḥ| sa eṣa bhasmajyotiḥ|| tathā mānavapurāṇe(-) bhasma jyotirbhavatyeva śivākhyaṃ na hi saṃśayaḥ| jābālopaniṣatsarvaṃ prāhedaṃ parayā mudā|| ityādi| atha rudrākṣa mahatvamāha(-) taditi| akṣa jābālakī atharvaṇe rudrākṣa jābālopaniṣatsaṃbandhinī yā trayī śrutirasti sā tadrudrākṣamiti pratīkavatī rudrākṣa jābālopaniṣadakṣamaṇi phalagaṇaṃ rudrākṣadhāraṇaṃ phala samūha muktvā jayati jagatāṃ dīpikāṃtāṃ namāmi| taduktaṃ atharvaṇi rudrākṣa jābālopaniṣadi(-) atha kālāgnirudraḥ provāca| tadrudrākṣaṃ vāgviṣayaṃ kṛte daśa go pradāne yatphala mavāpnoti tatphala maśnute sa eṣa jyoti rudrākṣamiti hovāca tadrudrākṣaṃ karo spraṣṭumicchan śata go pradāna phalaṃ bhavati tadrudrākṣadhāraṇaṃ katumicchan dviśata gopradāna phalaṃ bhavati| tadrudrākṣadhāraṇamātreṇa sahasra go pradāna phalaṃ bhavati| tadrudrākṣaṃ karayordhāryamāṇe dvi sāhasra gopradāna phalaṃ bhavati| tadrudrākṣaṃ kaṇṭhe dhāryamāṇe trisahasra gopradāna phalaṃ bhavati| karṇayordhāryamāṇe ekādaśa sahasra go pradāna phalaṃ bhavati| ekādaśa rudratvaṃ ca gacchati| śirasi dhāryamāṇe koṭi gopradānaphalaṃ bhavati| eteṣāṃ sthānānāṃ karṇayoḥ phalaṃ vaktuṃ na śakyamiti hovāca| tathā mānava purāṇe(-) rudrākṣaṃ dhārayan pāpaṃ kurvannapi ca mānavaḥ| sarvaṃ tarati pāpmānaṃ jābāla śrutirāha hi|| ityādi| vistara bhayānna likhitam| atha pañcākṣara svarūpamāha(-) raudreti| rudropaniṣatpañcākṣara
muktvā jayati jagatāṃ dīpikāṃ tāṃ namāmi| taduktaṃ yajuṣi śrīrudropaniṣadi(-) namaḥ śivāya ca śivatarāya ca tathā śivajñāna vidyāyām(-) vedānāṃ yajuṣāṃ madhye śata rudre vyavasthitam| pramāṇaṃ vedavākyatvātparamārtha prakāśitam|| tathā sūtasaṃhitāyām(-) eṣā pañcākṣarī vidyā śatarudrīya madhyagā| pāvanī sarva bhūtānāṃ rudraikādaśanī tataḥ|| siddhāntaśikhāmaṇau(-) namaḥ śabdaṃ vadetpūrvaṃ śivāyeti tataḥ param| mantraḥ pañcākṣaro hyeṣaḥ sarvaśruti śirogataḥ|| saptakoṭiṣu mantreṣu mantraḥ pañcākṣaro mahān| brahma viṣṇvādi rudreṣu yathā śaṃbhurmahattaraḥ|| ityādi| atha śivaliṅgadhāraṇamāha(-) raudrī tu| tu śabdaḥ pūrvasmādvailakṣaṇyaṃ dyotayati bhāṣyavacanāt| śatarudrīyopaniṣadapi śrīśiva janimadhṛtiṃ śrīmacchivaliṅgadhāraṇamuktvā jayati jagatāṃ tāṃ dīpikāṃ namāmi| tathā yajūṣi śatarudrīye (-) yā te rudra śivātanūra ghorā pāpakāśinī| tathā siddhāntaśiromaṇau(-) śivaḥ sarva gataścāpi svādhāre vyajyate'dhikam| śamī garbhe yathā vahnirviśeṣeṇa vibhāvyate|| sarvagatvaṃ maheśasya sarvaśāstra viniścitam| tathāpyāśraya liṅgādau pūjārthamadhikāsthitiḥ|| nityaṃ bhāti tvadī yeṣu yā te rudra śivā tanūḥ| aghorā pāpakāśīti śrutirāha sanātanī|| yā te rudra śivā tanūraghorā pāpakāśinīti| yajuṣā gīyate yasmātasmāccaivoghavarjitaḥ| vedaśāstra purāṇeṣu kāmikadyāgameṣau ca|| liṅgadhāraṇamākhyātaṃ vīraśaivasya niścayāt|| tathā skānde(-) śāṅkara saṃhitāyām(-) svapnakoṭi kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ brahmahatyādikaṃ ca yat|
yathā prabodha samaye tanmithyā bhavati sphuṭam|| tathaiva svakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ liṅga dhāraṇataḥ purā| yadasti tallayaṃ yāti liṅga dhāraṇataṣpa(pa)ram|| pavitramityādi ṛgvede(-) puṣpasya surabhiryadvaddehasya liṅgakam| ityādi vīratantre'pyuktam| vistara bhayānna likhitam|| atha śivaliṅga pādatīrtha sevāmāha(-) jābāleti| jābālaśākhā sevyatīrthaṃ svīkārya śiva pādodaka muktvā jayati jagatāṃ dīpikāṃ tāṃ namāmi| taduktaṃ jābāla śākhāyām(-) bhagavataḥ pādau prakṣālya śaṅkhaṃ prapūrya gandhapuṣpākṣatādibhirabhyarcya caruṃ nivedya śyaṃ(maṃ)me gaṅgāyamunetyabhimantrya kadrudrāyeti mā tvā rudreti sammārjanaṃ kṛtvā ṛtaṃ satyaṃ paraṃ brahmeti prāśayet| ya evaṃ kuryāt sa kulajān daśa pūrvān daśāva(pa)rān ātmānaṃ ca tārayet| tathābhiyukta sūktiḥ(-) yacca vākyaṃ bhagavataḥ pādāvityetadādikam| asti jābāla śākhāyāmīśa pādodakasya hi|| sevā vidhāna kathanaṃ tadvākyamapi kīrtitam|| tathā śivajñāna saṃgrahe(-) tataḥ pātraṃ pratiṣṭhāya pādod samanvitam| arcayedgandha puṣpādyairupacārairanekadhā|| tatpātraṃ śirasā dhṛtvā dhanyo'hamiti saṃsmaran| iyaṃ(maṃ) me gaṅgāyamunetyabhimantrya tataḥ param|| kadrudrāyeti mantreṇa mā tvā rudreti mantrataḥ| gṛhītvā pāṇinā tīrthaṃ sarvāṅgamabhiṣecayet|| sarvo vai rudra mantreṇa dvābhyāṃ ca prāśayettataḥ| ṛtaṃ satyaṃ paraṃ brahma puruṣaṃ kṛṣṇa piṅgalam|| ūrdhvaretaṃ virūpākṣaṃ viśvarūpāya vai namaḥ|
iti śeṣaṃ pibettīrthaṃ jñānavairāgya siddhaye|| brahmāṇḍa purāṇe ca(-) pādodakaṃ purabhidaḥ pāśajāla haraṃ param| pāṇi śuktibhirādāya papuḥ kāmaṃ gaṇeśvarāḥ|| ityādi| atha śivaprasāda svīkāramāha(-) jābāla śākhā tu| jābālopaniṣadapi(-)sevya prasādaṃ svīkārya śivaprasāda muktvā jayati jagatāṃ dīpikāṃ tāṃ jābālopaniṣadaṃ namāmi vande| tathā jābālopaniṣadi(-)rudreṇāttamaśnanti rudreṇa pītaṃ pibanti rudreṇa ghrātaṃ jighranti| tasmādbrahmaṇāḥ praśānta manaso vidvāṃso nirmālyameva bhakṣayanti| nirmālyameva niṣeveta nirmālyamevaśanīyāt|| tathā siddhānta śikhāmaṇau(-) bhuñjīyādrudra bhuktānnaṃ rudrapītaṃ jalaṃ pibet| rudrāghrātaṃ sadā jighrediti jābālakī śrutiḥ|| tathā skānde(-) śiṣṭāśśāntāśca rudreṇa bhuktameva hi bhuñjate| ghrātameva hi jighranti pītameva pibanti ca|| tathā cābhiyukta sūktiḥ(-) vidvāṃsaḥ paramārthajñāḥ praśānta manaso'nvaham| śānta cittā brāhmaṇā hi rudreṇārti prahāriṇā|| śivenāttaṃ tena bhuktamevāśnantyupa bhuñjate| rudreṇa pītaṃ pibati rudreṇāghrātameva hi|| jighra(ghraṃ)ti nirmālyameva bhakṣayantyavadhānataḥ| tasmāddhetorhi nirmālyamevāśnīyāditi sphuṭam|| ityādi yajuṣi rudreṇāttamamṛtamityādyuktaṃ vistara bhayānna likhitam|| iṣṭaṃ prāṇaṃtvatharva śruti śirasi gataṃ lakṣaṇaṃ vājapāyāḥ| śrīśāvāsya(śya) śrutau ṣaṇmukhakaraṇamidaṃ yājñavalkya śrutīṣyam| tejo bindu trayī haṃsa nigama śirasorbindunāda svarupī jñāte vārāṇaśīṃ tāṃ sakala śruti śikhā yattadāhurnamāmi||
itthaṃ pūrvoktaśloka dvacena śivādhikyādi bāhyamupadeśa muktvā itaḥ paramuttara śloka dvayeneṣṭa liṅgādyāntaraṅgikamupadeśaṃ darśayitu matraśloke iṣṭaliṅga prāṇaliṅgājapāyoga ṣaṇmukhīkaraṇa bindunāda vārāṇaśī tāraka brahmalakṣaṇānyati saṃkṣepato darśayati iṣṭamiti| atharvaśruti śirasi atharvaśiropaniṣadi iṣṭaṃ iṣṭaliṅgasvarūpaṃ gataṃ jñātam| sarve gatyarthā dhātavo jñānārthā iti bhāṣya vacanāt| taduktamatharva śiropaniṣadi (-) iṣṭamūrjaṃtapasānuyacchata iti| tathā vātule tantre(-) sakalaṃ dṛkkalā grāhyamiṣṭaliṅga sthalaṃ mahat| iṣṭāvāpti karaṃ sākṣādaniṣṭa parihārakam|| iṣṭamūrjaḥ svabhaktānā manuyaccati sarvadā|| iṣṭaṃ liṅgamiti prāha tasmādātharvaṇī śrutiḥ|| tathā sūtagītāyām(-) ghṛtakāṭhinyavanmūrtiḥ saccidānanda lakṣaṇā| śivādbhedena naivāsti śiva eva hi sā sadā|| ityādi| atheṣṭa liṅgasya prāṇabhūtaṃ prāṇaliṅgasvarūpamāha(-) prāṇamiti| prāṇaṃ tu prāṇaliṅgamapi atharvaśruti śirasi vā atharvaśiropaniṣadyeva gataṃ jñātam| vāsyādvikalpopamayorevārthe ca samuccaye| iti viśvaḥ| tathātharvaśiropaniṣadi(-)prāṇeṣvantarmanaso(sā) liṅgamāhuriti| tathā vātulatantre(-) prāṇaliṅgaṃ manogrāhyaṃ bhavetsakala niṣkalam| tatprāṇeṣṭaṃṣvantarmanaso liṅgamāhuriti śrutiḥ|| tathāditya purāṇe(-) prāṇeṣvantarmanasaṃ liṅgamāhuryasmin krodho yā ca tṛṣṇā kṣamā ca| tṛṣṇāṃcchitvā pāśajālasya mūlaṃ buddhyā saṃcintyasthāpayitvātha rudre|| ityādi| vistara bhayānnalikhitam|| athājapāmāha(-) śrīti| ajapāyā lakṣaṇaṃ ajapāyoga svarūpaṃ
śrīśāvāśya śrutau(-) śrīmadīśāvāsyopaniṣadi gataṃ jātam| taduktamīśāvāsyopaniṣadi(-) yo sā vasau puruṣaḥ so'ham| tathā sūtasaṃhitāyām(-) athāhamiti mantro'yaṃ jīvātma pratipādakaḥ| śaktimantraḥ sakārākhyaḥ parameśvara vācakaḥ| prakṛtārthe prasiddhatvātprasiddhaḥ parameśvaraḥ|| saṃsāre(ri)tvena bhāvo'haṃ sa eva parameśvaraḥ| so'hameva na sandehaḥ svānubhūti pramāṇataḥ|| śrutirapyevamevāha paramārtha prakāśinī| evaṃ vākyānusāriṇyā yuktyācārya purassaram| ahaṃ saḥ so'hameveti vijānīyādvicakṣaṇaḥ|| haṃsopaniṣadi(-) haṃsahaṃseti sadāye sarveṣṭha deheṣu vyāpto vartate| yathā hyagniḥ kāṣṭheṣu tileṣu tailamiva taṃ viditvā na mṛtyumeti| atha haṃsa ṛṣiḥ avyakta gāyatraṃcchandaḥ paramahaṃso devatā| ṣaṭ saṃkhyāhorātrayorekaviṃśati sahasrāṇi ṣaṭ śatānyadhikāni bhavanti| tathā viveka mārtaṇḍe(-) sakāreṇa bahiryāti hakāreṇa viśenmarut| haṃsahaṃseti tanmantraṃ jīvo japati sarvadā|| śatāni ṣaḍdivārātrau sahasrāṇyeka viṃśatiḥ| ajapā nāma gāyatrī yogināṃ mokṣadāyinī|| asyāḥ saṅkalpa mātreṇa naraḥ pāpaiḥ pramucyate|| tathā yoga bīje(-) sakāreṇa bahiryāti hakāreṇa viśenmarut| haṃsahaṃseti mantro'yaṃ sarve jīvā japantitam|| guru vākyātsuṣumnāyāṃ viparīto bhavejjapaḥ| so'haṃ so'hamiti prāpte mantrayogaḥ sa ucyate||
pratītirmantrayogācca jāyate paścime pathi|| tathā śivayoga pradīpikāyām(-) sakārāntamidaṃ bījaṃ bahiryāti sa bindukam| savisarga ṣakārāntaṃ bījamantarviśedadaḥ| ajapā nāma saṃkalpya naraḥ pāpaiḥ pramucyate|| śivayogamavāpnoti śīghrameva na saṃśayaḥ|| ityādi| atha ṣaṇmukhī mudrākaraṇaṃ yājñavalkya śrutī'yam| yājñavalkyopaniṣatstutyaṃ gataṃ jñātam| tathā yājñavalkyopaniṣadi(-) śakyamāsanamāsthāya samāhita manāstathā| karaṇāni vaśīkṛtya viṣayebhyo balātsudhīḥ|| apānamūrdhvamākṛṣya praṇavena samāhitaḥ| hastābhyāṃ bandhayetsamyak karṇādi karaṇāni vai|| aṅguṣṭhābhyāmubhe śrotre tarjanībhyāṃ tu cakṣuṣī| nāsāpuṭāvathānyābhyā pracchādya karaṇāni ca|| ānandā virbhavaṃ yāvat tāvanmūrdhani dhārayet| prāṇaḥ prayātyanenaiva tatastvāyurvighāta kṛt|| brahmarandhre suṣumnāyāṃ mṛṇālāntara sūtravat| nādotpattistvanenaiva śuddhasphaṭika sannibhaḥ|| āṃ mūdhno vartate nādo vīṇā daṇḍavadutthitaḥ| śaṃkhadhvani nibhastvādau madhye meghadhavaniryathā|| vyomarandha gate nāde giri prasravaṇaṃ yathā| vyomarandhra gate vāyau citte svātmani saṃsthite|| tathā nandī bhaveddehī vāyustena jito bhavet|| tathā siddhāntaśekhare(-) vajrāsanaṃ samādāya karṇādīn bandhayedyathā| aṃguṣṭhābhyāmubhau karṇau tarjanībhyāmathākṣiṇī||
madhyamābhyāṃ nibadhnīyānnāsikā yugalaṃ dṛḍham| ṣaṇmukhī karaṇaṃ hyetannādotpāttau praśasyate|| tathā śvetāśvataropaniṣadi (-) manonukūle na tu cakṣuḥ pīḍane guhāni vātā śrayeṇa prayojayet| nīhāra dhūmārka jalānalānāṃ khadyotavidyutsphaṭikaḥ śaśīnām| etāni rūpāṇi purassarāṇi brahmaṇyabhi vyakti karāṇi yoge|| tathā śiva yoga pradīpikāyām(-) vaktre cāpūrya vāyuṃ hutavaha nilaye'pānamākṛṣya dhṛtvā svāṅguṣṭhādyaṅgulībhirvara karatalayo ṣaḍbhirevaṃ nirudhya| śrotre netre ca nāsāpuṭa yugalamathānena mārgeṇa dhīrāḥ paśyanti pratyayānsapraṇava bahuvidhadhvāna saṃlīna cittāḥ|| ityādi| vistara bhayānna likhitam|| atha bindu lakṣaṇamāha(-) teja iti| tejo bindutrayī śirasi tejobindūpaniṣadi bindu svarūpaṃ jñātam| tathātharvaṇe tejobindaipaniṣadi(-) tejo bindu paraṃ dhyānaṃ viśvātītaṃ hṛdisthitam| āṇavaṃ śāmbhavaṃ śāktaṃ sthūlaṃ sūkṣmaṃ paraṃ ca yat|| tathā niśvāsakārikāyām(-) dhūmābhra paṭalākāraṃ vistīrṇaṃ sarvatomukham| dṛśyate naśyate caiva khadyota sadṛśa dyutiḥ|| hari kuṃkuma saṃkāśo madhyamo bindurucyate|| netra madhya sthito dīptaḥ pūryate svena tejasā|| śuddha sphaṭika saṃkāśo bindurjñeyaḥ parātparaḥ| daśa devamayaṃ binduṃ daśakarma phalapradam|| daśarūpaṃ ca boddhavyaṃ sūkṣmātsaikṣmataraṃ param| sitaṃ raktaṃ tathā kṛṣṇaṃ nīlaṃ megha sāprabham| pīta raktañca pītañca kapilaṃ dhūmrameva ca||
daśamaṃ sphaṭikābhaṃ ca phalameṣāṃ pṛthak pṛthak| nirvaśī karaṇe śvetaṃ raktaṃ bhūta vināśane|| piśāca nāśane kṛṣṇaṃ śivenoktaṃ mahātmanā| sarvagraha vināśāya nīlaṃ vai parikīrtatam|| meghābhaṃ vyādhi nāśāya pītaraktañca māraṇe| pītamākarṣaṇe caiva māraṇe kapilaṃ smṛtam|| sarvakarma sudhūmrābhaḥ sphaṭikābhastu mokṣadaḥ| śvetādīnāñca sarveṣāṃ bindūnāṃ devatāḥ kramāt|| a(na)nteśādayo mukhyāḥ śikhaṇḍyantāḥ prakīrtitāḥ| kālāgnirudro navamo daśamastu sadā śivaḥ|| idaṃ mukhyaṃ śivākhyasya bindudevasya lakṣaṇam| bindu dhyānātsadā yogī yogasiddhimavāpnuyāt|| ityādi| atha nāda svarūpamāha(-) haṃseti| haṃsanigama śirasi haṃsopaniṣadi nāda svarūpaṃ jñātam| tathā haṃsopaniṣadi(-) eṣosau paramahaṃso bhānu koṭi pratīkāśo asyaiva japakoṭyā nāda manu bhavati| sa ca daśavidha upajāyate| ciṇiti prathamaṇic | ciṇiti dvitīyaḥ| ghaṇṭānādastṛtīyaḥ| śaṅkhanādaścaturthaḥ| pañcamastantrīnādaḥ| ṣaṣṭhastālanādaḥ| saptamo veṇunādaḥ| aṣṭamo bherīnādaḥ| navamo mṛdaṅga nādaḥ| daśamo meghanādaḥ| navamaṃ parityajya daśamamevābhyaset| tasmin manovilīne manasi gate saṅkalpa vikalpe dagdhe puṇya pāpe sadā śivom| tathā śivāloke ciṇ ciṇ ciṇ| ghaṇṭā punaḥ śaṃkhadhvanayonu vallakī ninādaḥ| sattāraveṣu bherīmardala nādādaśoditā nādāḥ| siddhāntaśekhare(-) nādābhyāsena cānena saṃbhavanti aṇimādayaḥ| bahudhā siddhayonyāśca dūraśravaṇa darśane||
ityādi vistara bhayānna likhitam| itthamiṣṭa prāṇā japā ṣaṇmukhī bindu nāda svarūpāṇyuktvā itaḥ paraṃ sakala śruti śiro gāyatrī śiraḥ prasiddhaṃ gurūpadeśa gamyaṃ paramātmajñānaṃ darśayati(-) sakaleti| sakala śruti śikhāḥ kṣetra jābālopaniṣadādīni samasta śruti śirāṃsi| tāṃ prasiddhāṃ prakrānta prasiddhānubhūtārthastacchabdo yacchabdopādānāṃ nāpekṣata iti bhāṣya vacanāt| vārāṇasīmavimuktakṣetram| yadvārāṇasī saṃsthaparamātmasvarūpaṃ tārakaṃ brahmāhuḥ| tadahaṃ namāmi vande| taduktaṃ kṣetrajābālopaniṣadi(-) athahyenamatriḥ papraccha yājñavalkyam| ya eṣo'vyakta ātmātaṃ kathamahaṃ vijānīyāmiti| sahovāca yājñavalkyaḥ (-) so'vimukta upāsyo ya eṣonanto'vyakta ātmā so'vimukte pratiṣṭhitaḥ| iti| so'vimuktaḥ kasmin pratiṣṭhita iti| varaṇāyāṃ nāśyāṃ ca madhye pratiṣṭhita iti| kā vaivaraṇā kā ca nāśīti| sarvānindriya kṛtān doṣān vārayatīti| tena varaṇā bhavati| sarvānindraya kṛnpāpānnāśayatīti tena nāśī bhavati| kathamaṃ vāsyāyanaṃ bhavatīti| bhruvorghrāṇasya ca yaḥ sandhiḥ sa eṣa dyaurlokasya parasya sandhiḥ| so'vimukta upāsya iti| atra hi jantoḥ prāṇeṣūtkramamāṇeṣu rudrastārakaṃ brahma vyācaṣṭe| yenāsāvamṛtī bhūtvā mokṣī bhavati| iti tathā sūtasaṃhitāyām (-) vārāṇasī mahāprājña bhruvorghrāṇasya madhyame| bhruvo ghrāṇasya yaḥ sandhiriti jābālakī śrutiḥ|| tathā kāśī khaṇḍe śivaḥ(-) sarvān pāpān vārayati yacca nāśayati kṣaṇāt| tatsthānaṃ vārāṇaśīti bhruvormadhyaṃ vidurbudhāḥ|| liṅgajyotistvamevārye liṅgī cāhaṃ maheśvaraḥ| tadetadavimuktākhyaṃ jyotirālokyatāṃ priye||
tathā śivaloke (-) saṅge hi gaṅgā yamunā taṭinyościtraṃ kimapyastyavimuktatatvam| yalliṅgyātm tārakātma jyotistadeveśa bhavaṃtamīkṣye|| kṣetre'vimukte jahato rudro sūn dakṣiṇa śrutau| vyācaṣṭe tārakaṃ brahma mokṣī bhavati nānyataḥ|| tathā mānava purāṇe(-) bhruvorghrāṇasya yaḥ sandhistatra vārāṇasī sthitā| tatrāvimuktaṃ kṣetraṃ tasmin rudraḥ ssadā sthitaḥ|| liṅga jyotiḥ svarūpeṇa sadā viśveśvarāhvayaḥ| saṃsāra tārakaḥ sākṣāt pūjanīyaḥ sa muktaye|| tathā śaṅkarasaṃhitāyām(-) bhrughrāṇa madhyeṣvavimukta deśe viśveśvarākhyaṃ paramātma liṅgam| dhyānāmṛtāsaktadhiyo mahānto dhyātvā parāṃ muktimavāpuranye|| ityādi vistara bhayānna likhitam| atha tadavimuktakṣetrasaṃsthamagnyādi pracura nāma yuktaṃ nāma yuktaṃ paramātmasvarūpaṃ tārakaṃ brahma sakala vedānta gāyatrī śirassvapi darśayati| śrīmadṛgvede(-) oṃ agnimīle purohitam||1|| yajurvede(-) namo'gnye'psumate||2|| sāmavede(-) namo'gnaye pṛthivī lokakṣite||3|| atharva śirasi(-) yo vai rudrassa bhagavān yaścāgnistasmai vai namo namaḥ||4|| śiva saṅkalpopaniṣadi(-) yo veda udakāttrayate sarvaloka maheśvaraḥ| ṛgyajussāmātharvaiśca tanme manaḥ śivaḥ saṃkalpamastu||1|| śrīrudropaniṣadi(-) namastārāya ca namaḥ śaṃbhave ca||2|| atharvaśiropaniṣadi(-) atha kasmāducyate tāraṃ yasmāduccāryamāṇa eva garbhajanma jarāmaraṇasaṃsāra mahadbhayāttarayati tasmāducyate tāram||3|| brahma vidyopaniṣadi(-) arghamātrā tu sā jñeyā praṇavasyoparisthitā||4||
